notes: STORY 4.3 FIXTURE — the class the calibrated run missed ENTIRELY and the
triagers rated CRITICAL. A repo-steerable state directory made a hook write a
live OAuth access token into an attacker's own working tree. There is no network
call anywhere in that path, so no v2.5 egress rule could see it.
The two sinks below are the SAME writeFileSync call with the same 0600 mode and
differ only in `path_control`. That is the whole point: the discriminator is who
chooses the path, not whether it is a file. `own_config` is story 2.5's benign
case and must stay silent; `repo` must be CRITICAL.

guarded_paths.enforced_gate: none — writeFileSync(mode 0o600) under $XDG_STATE_HOME, a path the device owns
none — writeFileSync(mode 0o600) under the path the repository named
